description: Narammala Pradeshiya Sabha - The Roads and Thoroughfares Owned by the Narammala Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land and property matters, specifically the official declaration and listing of roads and thoroughfares owned and maintained by the Pradeshiya Sabha Narammala local government authority. It includes detailed schedules with property identifiers, coordinates, dimensions, and legal status determinations regarding land ownership - all characteristic of land gazettes. While it involves local government, the core content focuses on property rights and land management rather than government personnel or organizational structure.
